svg.aria-label: Streams — MEC Networks Corporation. Field-service dispatch for three clients, co-developed in a four-person team on Laravel 12, React 19 and Flutter: GPS tracking, service reports, client sign-off and billing across 12 role types and ~190 endpoints, with real-time collaborative reporting over Reverb and five enterprise systems synced through fault-tolerant queues.
